missing_items: Archive-modification precedent. M04 inserted an erratum block into M03's final verdict file (mission-03/SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:5-10, commit 463a76a). M07 instead used a separate ERRATA_M05_M06.md and left the archives unchanged. M08 brief principle 7 forbids rewriting M01-M07 files, so M08 must follow the M07 model and should log the M04 edit as a precedent not to repeat.

M03 relied on M02's unbacked N-LEARN-1 numbers. UNKNOWNNESS_AUDIT L3 argues '被动学习的过度泛化发生在更少的轨迹上', citing N-LEARN-1. The same audit states '没有发现与仓库记录不一致的数字' (UNKNOWNNESS_AUDIT.md:19, :76-80). M03's audit therefore inherited and certified a figure with no committed raw data.

M03 knew of the cond_delay channel but removed it only partly. UNKNOWNNESS_AUDIT.md:15 notes that M02's learner aligns using the declared delay D (src/cog/learn.py:85). P1 then claims not to use cond_delay, yet still draws traces through _random_trace, which paces by cond_delay (src/cog/learn.py:55-57; run_p1.py:44-56). The leak was known and not plugged, not merely missed.

M06 G4-h reliability contrast reduces to a policy flag. B1-LPR's recovery re-issues commands and checks `expect in obs`, the same substring check as the monitor (mission-06/experiments/g4/g4_core.py:22-31; alf_core.py:119-122). The '0 vs 5 silent failures' difference is therefore only abstain versus continue after 3 failed attempts. Compositional contracts play no part in it.

M03: on the ARC-AGI-1 held-out set, M-DISC-MDL's 12 correct answers are exactly the 12 of A3-no-uniqueness (arbitrary first cover). The MDL tie-break added no correct answer over random cover choice (mission-03/experiments/arc/arc_evaluation.json rows).

M07: all L2 events in alpha occur on the single world seed 205, across CAND, F-MB-fast and F-MB-slow. Those arms are near-identical agents on the same world, so the passes are not independent replications. Seed/world layout is a confound for any 'organisational' reading (g4_results_alpha.json per_seed.205).

M07: B1 and B1+M have identical summary rows (L1 1, lives 52.4, 0 structures). B1+M learned nothing, so the 'structure for planning only' baseline was never actually exercised (g4_results_alpha.json arms.B1, arms.B1+M).

M01: E-dev-1 shows a negative claim produced by a bug. compose_dag's observational-equivalence pruning reported a false EXHAUSTED and missed counter(k=3) (evidence-ledger.md:51). Together with M01's bound-64, M04's invalid enumeration pruning bound (a9f96cdd AMBIGUOUS→UNIQUE, AUDIT_M03_UNIQUENESS.md:63-65) and M03's dominance pruning, it shows that negative or uniqueness claims depended on implementation correctness several times. The readers list bound-64 but not E-dev-1.

M07 G0 audit also misdescribes M03's goal sources. Its M03 row gives only 'ARC-AGI-1 任务（第三方）', but M03's positive results (P1, confirmation 6/6, R6, L2) are all on designer-generated DEV tasks from M02/M03 generators (mission-07/G0_AUDIT.md:13; mission-03/SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md 'DEV 表示任务由本会话的生成器产生').

The repository never recorded the origin question. No M01-M06 markdown file contains 生物/biolog/connectome/连接组. README.md:3 frames the project from M01 onward as '能力规格 → 可验证网络'. Biology appears only in M07, as fruit-fly functional hypotheses ('生物相似性本身不计分', HYPOTHESES.md:36), and FlyWire as 'reference only'. The 2026-09-28 question first appears in mission-08/MISSION_08_BRIEF.md:14. The drift therefore began at M01's framing, not mid-series.

Designer briefs to 'independent' held-out authors steered difficulty in both directions. The M05 G4 brief required at least 2/3 of designs to achieve the atom (G4_DESIGN.md:72), pushing toward success. The M07 beta brief said to avoid simple counters (BETA_AUTHOR_BRIEF.md:39-40), pushing outside M and toward failure. In both cases the held-out set measures the brief's effect rather than an independent distribution.

M02: the pre-registered M2-H2 threshold of at least 70% failed for the only non-LLM route (A-auto 62.5%) and was scored '部分成立'. The headline Construction row still reads SUPPORTED_IN_TOY_DOMAIN, resting on A-LLM 16/16, which M03 L1 later reproduced with a lookup table (SCIENTIFIC_VERDICT.md:11,52; mission-03/UNKNOWNNESS_AUDIT.md:61-65).

M05 P1.4 was scored HOLDS although the predicted outcome (A-FLAT RESOURCE_LIMIT at 600 s) did not occur; the actual outcome was NO_CONSISTENT_LIST. This is a verdict rounded up because the falsification clause did not trigger, the same pattern as M01 H2 (pa1_scores.json P1.4; A05_PROTOCOL.md:147).

M07: M2 composites mutate in place when their counter is revised (cand.py:486-488). Grounding and provenance for any M2 are therefore evaluated against a later structure. This affects s2 on seed 205 and makes the M02-style 'chain' evidence at the structure level time-inconsistent.

M04 CP1 failed on the upper bound for the law-holding fraction (33.3% against 19.75%); the 3.08x ratio passed. Combined with the shape confound (1.31x on the comparable subset), the ratio criterion also fails once the artefact is removed. The retraction is therefore over-determined (CONFIRMATION_ARC2_RESULTS.md:21,36).
cross_mission_patterns: The answer is inside the designer's hypothesis space by construction. Examples: M02's learner can output only OR-disjunctions; M03's G-geo prior is a near-minimal superset of A_POOL, and its 22 guards include the true regions; M05's potential grammar equals the templates, and its rule grammar mirrors model.select; M04's 9-rule grammar; M07's grids contain alpha's exact theta, D, delta, dctx and T. For M08, if the candidate rule family is built from known generative features (cell type, birth time, distance, pruning, as in Richter & Schneidman 2025), recovering it is 复现, not discovery. M08 needs feature-ablated and feature-shuffled controls, plus a generic model of matched capacity (latent-space or SBM) chosen before fitting.

Held-out sets come from the designer's own generator, its closure, or briefs that steer them. Examples: M01 D from the seeded designer grammar; M02 unseen tasks inside the depth-2 vocabulary closure; M03 confirmation regions limited to top and left; M03 R6 held-out regions built as D4 or shift images of training regions; M05 G3/G4 written in the designer DSL with a brief demanding achieving designs; M06 G4b goals filtered with judge-side facts; M07 beta/gamma steered outside M. For M08, held-out must be independently acquired biological data: other individuals or developmental stages (e.g., a different C. elegans dataset), another dataset or hemisphere for the fly, not random edge or neuron splits of the same graph. Left/right homolog pairs leak structure across such splits.

Judge truth leaks through data generators, interfaces, labels and co-designed judges. Examples: M02 tasks.json ground-truth params; M03 cond_delay pacing of passive traces; M05 applicability_cex used both in the certificate and in the metric; M06 H_co derived from an admissible_commands audit; the M06 G4b LIT judge co-designed with the constructor's macro, and the after-win 'Nothing happens.' mask. Biological analogues for M08: cell-type annotations and neurotransmitter predictions are partly derived from connectivity or the same EM data, so 'type predicts wiring' can be circular; physiological parameters tuned on the same recordings later used as 'prediction targets'; benchmark metrics chosen after seeing fits.

Baselines are crippled, mismatched or not run. Examples: M01 compares against a naive one-hot construction; M02 HP-1 got one 600 s run at a single size; M05 A-FLAT is a weak flat baseline; M06 B1 ran without the monitor although the plan required no weaker knowledge; M07 B5 is close to B4 (identical L1 on 8/10 alpha seeds), B6 was never run, Craftax B4 was skipped, and the equal-capacity non-biological fly controls were never built. For M08: run published strong baselines with matched compute (configuration and degree-corrected SBM, distance-only and geometric models, ERGM, the Richter-Schneidman generator, connectome-constrained versus shuffled or random-connectivity dynamical models, and a trained RNN as in Lappalainen 2024). The connectome-based model must beat these to claim G-FUNCTION.

Bounded or pruned searches get reported as impossibility or uniqueness. Examples: M01 fsm bound 64 and 'no network of any size'; compose_dag's false EXHAUSTED; C3 n=1 UNREALIZABLE as a template artifact; M02 HP-1 timeout read as 'eliminated'; M03/M04 dominance pruning, cap 200, islice 256, and an invalid pruning bound. In M08, claims that 'no compact rule explains X' or 'rule R is uniquely selected' must state the search space and budget and report model-selection uncertainty across individuals (bootstrap or leave-one-animal-out).

Documented numbers are not regenerated from committed raw files, and errors persist across audits. Examples: M01 LOG 32 vs 16, ledger:57 and ledger:274; M02 N-LEARN-1 (certified by M03's audit); M04 '5→9' credited to background; M06 2,660 vs 2,360 and the 'G4-f' label; M07 LIMITATIONS contradicting the Craftax results and s2 called 'true parameters'. M08 should produce every tabled number from committed outputs by script and have the Gate audit recompute them.

Positives sit at the threshold edge, have low power, or depend on a single world. Examples: M07's only L2 is exactly 3x and every L2 event is on seed 205; M04 R6 is 3.0x on the comparable subset, and its twin class has 5 pairs; M03 uniqueness is 6/7 vs 12/16; M01's 10/10 has a 95% lower bound of 0.69. Biological connectome samples are tiny (a handful of C. elegans individuals or stages, one whole adult fly brain). M08 must treat animals or datasets as the unit of replication, not synapses or neurons, and pre-register effect sizes.

Verdicts are rounded up or failed pre-registered tests reframed. Examples: M01 H2 'supported' with D05 and D12 timing out; M02 M2-H2 'partial' while Construction is 'SUPPORTED'; M05 P1.6 falsified but status says '部分', and P1.4 'HOLDS' with a different outcome; M07 H1 '成立' at p = 0.055, the Craftax support condition failed and was relabelled 'capability level', and Holm was never reported. M08 should map pre-registered criteria to verdicts mechanically in code and keep G-STRUCT, G-FUNCTION and G-CONSTRUCT separate.

The neural substrate is never necessary, and neural or biological vocabulary relabels symbolic machinery. Examples: M02 H6; M03 H-0n; M05/M06 FSM-to-IF compilation, with no external controller ever compiled to a network; M07 plain Python, with fly 'mechanisms' implemented as one-line knobs. For M08 this means the H0-TOPO, H0-KNOWN and principle-4 tests: show that the structure-derived dynamics, not a fitted readout, carry the predictive power, using shuffled-connectome and readout-only controls.

Operational definitions make claims true by construction. Examples: M07's S0 is memoryless, so latent goal classes are inexpressible by definition; M02's '353 rules, 1 template' follows from the learner class; M05's grammar equals the templates; M04's law_K is false whenever shapes differ. For M08, 'compact generative law' must be measured against a memorisation or description-length baseline (edge list, SBM) under the same coding scheme, or compactness will be guaranteed by the chosen metric.

Development-time tuning on the evaluation family is followed by 'confirmation' from the same source. Examples: M03 amendments 1, 3 and 4 on the same DEV tasks; M04 amendments 1-3 and 5; M05 A+ and A++ designed from G3 held-out diagnoses; M07's six candidate revisions made with alpha's true D known. M08 should freeze model families, features, metrics and splits before touching held-out individuals or stages, and record custody of held-out data.

Designer, generator, baseline and proposer are the same model family, so pretraining contamination cannot be excluded. Examples: M01 blind session; M05 G3/G4 authors; M06 B2 (Opus 5.5); M07 beta/gamma authors. M08's executor may already know the published C. elegans and FlyWire analyses, including the Richter-Schneidman features. Rules 'found' must be traced to literature recall versus data, and the knowledge budget must say so.

The question drifts and designer artifacts substitute for biological structure. Across seven missions 'structure' became FSMs, IR templates, symbolic grids, achiever libraries or meta-language M, and 'capability' became designer specs or benchmark success. The biological question never appears in any M01-M07 document, and the README framing replaced it from M01 onward. M08 Gate 0 must state this explicitly and prevent drift back to designer-written tasks.

Structural or representational success is reported without functional consequence. Examples: M04 conservation-law specificity gave no coverage gain (10 vs 10); M07 grounded structures left lives unchanged (531 vs 531); M01 neuron-count gaps were measured against a naive baseline. This maps directly to M08's H0-TOPO: structural fit and functional prediction must be reported and judged separately.
